classification_rules.negative: DEV_NO_GO if all complete but candidate fails improvement over strongest control on both scenarios, or if old return regression exceeds 0.01; stop and do not retune on same cohort.
classification_rules.supported: DEV_PROMISING_ONLY if all four seed changed-stage Brier values beat every fully fitted equal-information control by >=0.005, A return Brier <= frozen +0.01 in every seed, no warmup spurious activation, four complete cold journals; never call SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
